mapper.sql: a.id, a.slug, CASE WHEN #{f.english} = TRUE AND a.translation_status = 'COMPLETED' AND a.title_en IS NOT NULL AND a.title_en != '' AND a.content_en IS NOT NULL AND a.content_en != '' THEN a.title_en ELSE a.title END AS title, a.title_en, CASE WHEN #{f.english} = TRUE AND a.translation_status = 'COMPLETED' AND a.title_en IS NOT NULL AND a.title_en != '' AND a.content_en IS NOT NULL AND a.content_en != '' THEN a.summary_en ELSE a.summary END AS summary, a.summary_en, a.translation_status, (a.translation_status = 'COMPLETED' AND a.title_en IS NOT NULL AND a.title_en != '' AND a.content_en IS NOT NULL AND a.content_en != '') AS has_english_translation, a.level, a.category_id, a.status, a.source_url, a.source_author, a.cover_url, a.view_count, a.word_count, a.published_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM article a
AND a.status = #{f.status}
AND a.level = #{f.level}
AND a.category_id = #{f.categoryId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM article_tag atg WHERE atg.article_id = a.id AND atg.tag_id = #{f.tagId})
AND MATCH(a.title, a.summary, a.content) AGAINST (#{f.ftsExpr} IN BOOLEAN MODE)
AND ( (a.translation_status = 'COMPLETED' AND a.title_en IS NOT NULL AND a.title_en != '' AND a.content_en IS NOT NULL AND a.content_en != '' AND MATCH(a.title_en, a.summary_en, a.content_en) AGAINST (#{f.ftsExpr} IN BOOLEAN MODE)) OR ((a.translation_status != 'COMPLETED' OR a.translation_status IS NULL OR a.title_en IS NULL OR a.title_en = '' OR a.content_en IS NULL OR a.content_en = '') AND MATCH(a.title, a.summary, a.content) AGAINST (#{f.ftsExpr} IN BOOLEAN MODE)) )
AND ( (a.translation_status = 'COMPLETED' AND a.title_en IS NOT NULL AND a.title_en != '' AND a.content_en IS NOT NULL AND a.content_en != '' AND (a.title_en LIKE #{p} OR a.summary_en LIKE #{p})) OR ((a.translation_status != 'COMPLETED' OR a.translation_status IS NULL OR a.title_en IS NULL OR a.title_en = '' OR a.content_en IS NULL OR a.content_en = '') AND (a.title LIKE #{p} OR a.summary LIKE #{p})) )
AND (a.title LIKE #{p} OR a.summary LIKE #{p})
ORDER BY a.view_count DESC, a.id DESC
ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC, a.id DESC
ORDER BY a.published_at DESC, a.id DESC
